usage: sot-validator synth-fleet [-h] --seed SEED [--sites SITES]
                                 [--subnets-per-site SUBNETS_PER_SITE]
                                 [--hosts-per-subnet HOSTS_PER_SUBNET] --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --seed SEED           Generator seed; the same seed and sizes always write identical files.
  --sites SITES         Number of sites, 1 to 254 (default: 100).
  --subnets-per-site SUBNETS_PER_SITE
                        Number of /24 subnets per site, 1 to 256 (default: 10).
  --hosts-per-subnet HOSTS_PER_SUBNET
                        Number of hosts per subnet, 0 to 245 (default: 60).
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Snapshot folder; sites are written to <output-dir>/sites/<site_id>.json
                        (created if missing).
